ven.errTitle: We could not load this page.
ven.errText: Try again. If it still fails, quote the reference below to RightOne support.
ven.vnTime: All times on this page are Vietnam time.
ven.refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED_FOR_PREMISES: RightOne cannot confirm that you may act for this premises. If you do, ask the premises principal to check your delegation, then try again.
ven.refusal.ENTITLEMENT_NOT_FOUND: There is no Player service for this premises, or you may not see it. Check the premises you chose, or enrol it if it is not enrolled yet.
ven.refusal.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: This verification document does not exist, or you may not see it. Open the service and issue a new one.
ven.refusal.PLAYLIST_NOT_FOUND: This playlist does not exist, or it belongs to another premises. Go back to your playlists and choose again.
ven.refusal.ALREADY_ENROLLED: This premises already has a Player service that has not ended. Open it from My premises services.
ven.refusal.ENTITLEMENT_NOT_PENDING: The terms are already accepted, or the service has ended. Open the service to see its status.
ven.refusal.TERMS_VERSION_SUPERSEDED: The terms you read could not be confirmed as the version in force, so your acceptance was not recorded. Reload the terms and accept the version shown.
ven.refusal.ALREADY_ENDED: This service has ended, or an ending is already waiting to take effect. Its code and history stay readable.
ven.refusal.ENTITLEMENT_PENDING: A verification document is issued only after the service terms are accepted. Accept the terms first, then issue the document.
ven.refusal.ENTITLEMENT_NOT_ACTIVE: The service is suspended, restricted, revoked or ended, so playlists, the default playlist and schedules cannot be changed. Nothing was saved.
ven.refusal.PLAYLIST_ARCHIVED: This playlist is archived, so it cannot be changed, scheduled or set as the default. Choose another playlist or create a new one.
ven.refusal.PLAYLIST_IN_USE: This playlist is the default or is used by a schedule in force, so it cannot be archived. Choose another default or withdraw the schedule first.
ven.refusal.SCHEDULE_NOT_ACTIVE: This schedule has already been withdrawn or replaced. Reload the schedules.
ven.refusal.PREMISES_CLASS_OUT_OF_SCOPE: The RightOne direct licence does not cover this kind of premises, so it cannot use the Player service. See the licence scope and the core licence route below.
ven.refusal.PREMISES_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_EF: The premises register does not show your organisation as operating this premises now, so it was not enrolled. If the register is out of date, correct it first.
ven.refusal.ATTESTATION_NOT_CONFIRMED: You did not tick the confirmation, so your acceptance was not recorded. Read the terms, tick the box and accept again.
ven.refusal.NO_DEFAULT_CONTENT: Nothing is set to play when no schedule applies, so the service cannot start and your acceptance was not recorded. Set a default playlist with an eligible track, then accept again.
ven.refusal.RULES_NOT_APPROVED: No approved playback rule is in force for that time, so what plays cannot be worked out. RightOne will fix this. There is nothing for you to do.
ven.refusal.EFFECTIVE_DATE_BEFORE_POLICY: The date you chose is earlier than the ending policy allows. Leave the date blank to end on the earliest date allowed, or choose a later one.
ven.refusal.FIELD_MISSING: A required value is missing. Fill in the marked field and send again.
ven.refusal.FIELD_NOT_PERMITTED: The request carried a value it may not set, so nothing was saved. Reload the page and try again.
ven.refusal.WORDING_NOT_APPROVED: The approved wording for the verification document is not in force yet, so no document was issued. RightOne will fix this. There is nothing for you to do.
ven.refusal.TRACK_NOT_ELIGIBLE: A track in this list is not eligible under the direct licence now, so nothing was saved. Remove it and save again.
ven.refusal.MOOD_NOT_EFFECTIVE: A shared mood in this list has no version in effect, so nothing was saved. Remove it or choose another mood, then save again.
ven.refusal.PLAYLIST_IN_USE_WOULD_BE_EMP: This change leaves a playlist in use with no eligible track, so it was not saved. Keep at least one eligible track, or stop using the playlist first.
ven.refusal.PLAYLIST_NO_ELIGIBLE_TRACK: This playlist has no track that can play now, so it cannot be scheduled or set as the default. Add an eligible track to it first.
ven.refusal.INVALID_TIME_RANGE: The start time must be before the end time on the same day, with 24:00 as the end of the day. An end date, if given, must be after the start date.
ven.refusal.NO_DAYS: Choose at least one day of the week for this schedule.
ven.refusal.EFFECTIVE_FROM_IN_PAST: The start date is before today in Vietnam time. Choose today or a later date.
ven.refusal.AS_OF_REQUIRED: Choose the time the result is worked out for. This field has no default.
ven.refusal.WINDOW_TOO_LONG: Choose a start date and an end date covering at most 31 days. The end cannot be before the start.
ven.refusal.CURSOR_INVALID: The page position, page size or a filter value is not valid, so the list could not be read. Reload the list from the start.
ven.pager.end: That is the end of the list.
ven.pager.label: Pages of the list
ven.pager.refusedTitle: This page of the list could not be read
ven.refusal.SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not check your authority, the premises class or the licence scope, so the premises was not enrolled or the service not started. The fault is RightOne's, so try again shortly.
ven.refusal.PREMISES_CLASS_UNRESOLVED: The premises register holds no premises class for this premises, so RightOne cannot tell whether the direct licence covers it. Record the class in the premises register, then send again.

ven.refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED: Your role cannot do this, or you prepared what is being approved and someone else must approve it. Ask the service owner who holds that authority.
ven.refusal.VERSION_NOT_FOUND: This shared mood version does not exist, or it is not available to you. Go back to the mood library and choose again.
ven.refusal.STATE_NOT_ENFORCEABLE: The service's current status does not allow this action. A suspension or restriction needs an active service, and a revocation one that is active, suspended or restricted.
ven.refusal.NOT_REINSTATABLE: Only a suspended or restricted service can be reinstated. An ended or revoked service does not become active again.
ven.refusal.MOOD_RETIRED: This shared mood is retired, so no new version can be prepared for it. Create a new mood instead.
ven.refusal.VERSION_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft version can be approved, and this one has already been approved or withdrawn.
ven.refusal.VERSION_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE: This version has already been superseded or withdrawn, so it cannot be withdrawn.
ven.refusal.RANGE_OVERLAP: This version's dates overlap another version of the mood, so it was not approved. A new version must start after the versions before it.
ven.refusal.POLICY_NOT_APPROVED: No enforcement policy version is in force, so no enforcement action can be recorded. The service owner approves the policy.
ven.refusal.GROUND_NOT_LISTED: This ground is not listed in the enforcement policy in force. Choose a listed ground.
ven.refusal.ACTION_NOT_PERMITTED_FOR_GRO: The enforcement policy does not permit this action for this ground. Choose the action the policy lists for it.
ven.refusal.RECORD_INCOMPLETE: An enforcement action needs its effective time, its remedy, a notice and, unless it is a revocation, its reinstatement conditions. Add what is missing and record it again.
ven.refusal.EFFECTIVE_AT_IN_PAST: The effective time is in the past. Choose now or a later time.
ven.refusal.CONDITIONS_NOT_MET: The service was not reinstated because a condition has no evidence, or the reinstatement time falls outside the span from when the action took effect to now. Reload the case file, check and try again.
ven.refusal.CAUSE_NOT_RECOGNISED: The detail you chose does not belong to the cause family chosen. Choose a detail from that family.
ven.refusal.VERSION_HAS_NO_ELIGIBLE_TRAC: This version has no track that is eligible now, so it was not approved. Prepare a version with at least one eligible track.
